name: How do I know if my roof needs a long-term protection plan or a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my roof needs a long-term protection plan or a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining whether your roof needs a protection plan or replacement depends on its age, extent of damage, and overall structural integrity. A long-term protection plan is suitable for roofs with minor, localized issues and a good remaining lifespan. If your roof is nearing the end of its expected life, has widespread damage, or multiple leaks, a full replacement is usually the more practical long-term solution. We can assess your roof to recommend the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess your roof's age, damage, and integrity; a protection plan suits minor issues, while widespread damage often requires replacement.
